Write a vitest file testing an HMAC-verified webhook route.
Shape (mirror src/app/api/webhooks/line tests):
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
- build raw JSON body string
- sign: crypto.createHmac('sha256', SECRET).update(rawBody).digest('base64' or 'hex' per route)
- POST via route handler with header set -> expect 200
- tamper body after signing -> expect 401
- omit signature header -> expect 401
Mock prisma/repos with vi.mock. Set env secret with vi.stubEnv.
